vehicles.mispar_rechev: skip: licence plate — a per-vehicle identifier, never shown
vehicles.shilda: skip: chassis (VIN) number — a per-vehicle identifier, never shown
vehicles.tozeret_cd: skip: numeric maker code, one-to-one with tozeret_nm which is shown
vehicles.sug_rechev_cd: skip: numeric vehicle-type code, one-to-one with sug_rechev_nm which is shown
vehicles.degem_nm: skip: 17,070 distinct model strings, mostly factory codes (e.g. 221.156) that mean nothing to a reader
vehicles.mishkal_kolel: skip: gross weight is 0 for 57% of vehicles — too sparse to chart
vehicles.shnat_yitzur: chart-vintage, chart-age, chart-fuel, chart-heat, kpi:median_year, insight:classic, insight:fuel_shift
vehicles.degem_manoa: skip: 6,058 engine-model codes (e.g. M272, 2GR) — not meaningful without a lookup
vehicles.mivchan_acharon_dt: kpi:total, insight:licence — defines the page's as-of date and the last-year inspection count in the lede
vehicles.moed_aliya_lakvish: skip: first road-entry month always equals the production year (first registration abroad, not the import date), so it adds nothing beyond shnat_yitzur
